component.name: GuideBackground
component.script:
sub init() m.video = m.top.findNode("video") m.image = m.top.findNode("image") m.videoConfigured = false m.imageConfigured = false m.top.visible = false m.top.observeField("videoKey", "configure") m.top.observeField("imageKey", "configure") m.top.observeField("opacityKey", "configure") m.top.observeField("fallbackOpacity", "configure") m.top.observeField("active", "updatePlayback") configure() end sub
sub configure() m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.video.content = invalid m.image.visible = false m.image.uri = "" m.videoConfigured = false m.imageConfigured = false
opacity = manifestOpacity(m.top.opacityKey, m.top.fallbackOpacity) videoUrl = manifestString(m.top.videoKey) if videoUrl <> "" content = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") content.url = videoUrl content.streamFormat = streamFormat(videoUrl) content.httpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt" m.video.opacity = opacity m.video.content = content m.videoConfigured = true else imageUrl = manifestString(m.top.imageKey) if imageUrl <> "" m.image.opacity = opacity m.image.uri = imageUrl m.imageConfigured = true end if end if updatePlayback() end sub
sub updatePlayback() shouldShow = m.top.active and (m.videoConfigured or m.imageConfigured) m.top.visible = shouldShow if m.videoConfigured if shouldShow m.video.visible = true m.video.control = "play" else m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false end if else m.image.visible = shouldShow and m.imageConfigured end if end sub
function manifestOpacity(key as string, fallback as float) as float appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid or text = "" then return fallback value = text.toFloat() if value < 0 then return 0 if value > 1 then return 1 return value end function
function manifestString(key as string) as string if key = "" then return "" appInfo = createObject("roAppInfo") text = appInfo.getValue(key) if text = invalid then return "" return text.trim() end function
function streamFormat(url as string) as string lowered = LCase(url) if instr(1, lowered, ".m3u8") > 0 then return "hls" if instr(1, lowered, ".mpd") > 0 then return "dash" return "mp4" end function
